segments.name: Cellular Broadband
segments.description: Builds a space-based Cellular Broadband network so mobile network operators and government users can connect everyday smartphones outside terrestrial coverage.
segments.evidence: The SpaceMobile Service is being designed to provide cost-effective, high-speed Cellular Broadband services to end-users who are out of terrestrial cellular coverage using existing mobile devices.

revenueModel.text: Mobile network operators and the U.S. government pay for SpaceMobile Service, gateway equipment, software and related services used by their subscribers and agencies.
revenueModel.evidence: We intend to seek to use a revenue-sharing business model for the SpaceMobile Service in our agreements with MNOs.
